body.p: As people say about the game among the Enets. Somewhere on earth in the spring a reindeer man rode. His reindeer suddenly got frightened, the reindeer man fell down, and his reindeer ran away forever with the sledge. Having stood up onto his feet, he looked around: oh, a wolf was running towards him. What should he do? It's scary to go forward, there's a big river flowing behind him. He cannot swim: the water is cold. And the wolf came very close to him. The reindeer man thinks: "Somehow I would like to stay alive." He jumped onto a stone that was in the water. From this stone he got to another stone. From this stone, he jumped to the shore, to the ground. The reindeer man is standing, looking at the wolf from the bank of the river. He thinks to himself: âHow did I stay alive? I crossed a deep river jumping, and even my boots remained dry. Since then, after him, Nenets, Nganasans, Enets, Dolgans have learned to play in such a jumping way. You understand where this game came from. Our boys compete with one another in such a way. Who wins against his friends, this person is strong, this person is deft.
